test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.**

There is an unhealthy tendency to (**subjugate**) films to the dictates of raising public awareness.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Liberate."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"subjugate"** means to bring under control or dominate. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु को परास्‍त करना; किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु का दमन करना या उसे अपने अधीन करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The original inhabitants of the area were **subjugated**__ by the conquerors from Spain.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of **'subjugate'** is** 'liberate.'**
 
• It means to set free or release from control. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को आज़ाद या मुक्त करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *India was **liberated**__ in 1947.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the author is criticizing the tendency to prioritize raising public awareness over artistic expression in films.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) Colonize** - This word is not a suitable antonym for 'subjugate' in this context because it implies the establishment of a new settlement or the extension of political control, rather than a release from control. (किसी देश या स्‍थान को उपनिवेश बनाना)
 
• **Option 2) Modest** - This word is not an antonym for 'subjugate' at all, as it means having a humble or unassuming attitude or appearance. (विनम्र, विनीत (अपनी क्षमताओं आदि का बखान न करने वाला))
 
• **Option 3) Vanquish** - This word is not a suitable antonym for 'subjugate' in this context because it means to defeat or overcome an enemy or opponent, rather than to release from control. ((स्‍पर्धा या युद्घ में) परास्‍त करना, अभिभूत करना)
